email_subject: Application - Corporate Marketeer at Immowi International
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Corporate Marketeer role at Immowi International. Your focus on brand strategy and positioning in real estate lead generation caught my attention—especially the opportunity to own a brand on an international growth path.

My background sits at the intersection of SEO, content, and web, with a strong emphasis on storytelling that ranks. At Episto, I handle on-page SEO and content for client websites, and I've built and optimized sites like mirook.com with structured data and AI-search visibility in mind. I use AI tools daily to automate research and audits, which helps me focus on the strategic and creative side of marketing.

I'm fluent in English and comfortable working cross-functionally. While my Dutch is still developing (writing B1, speaking A2+), I'm committed to improving it and believe my strategic instincts and technical skills can add real value to Immowi's brand.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Corporate Marketeer position at Immowi International. Your emphasis on brand strategy, positioning, and differentiation in real estate lead generation resonates with my approach to marketing: build a clear story, make it consistent, and back it with data.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage SEO content and on-page optimization for client websites, from keyword research to publishing. I've also built and optimized sites like mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and technical SEO to improve search visibility—including AI-powered search. This hands-on experience has taught me how to craft messaging that works across platforms and how to use AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, freeing up time for strategic thinking.

What draws me to Immowi is the chance to own a brand on an international growth path. I enjoy working cross-functionally and have collaborated with teams to align content with business goals. My technical background in web development and SEO gives me a practical understanding of how to execute campaigns effectively. While my Dutch is at B1 writing and A2+ speaking, I'm actively improving it and am confident in my English fluency and communication skills.

I'm a strong storyteller with sharp strategic instincts, and I'm eager to bring that mix to Immowi. I'd love to discuss how my experience in SEO, content, and AI-driven marketing can help elevate your brand.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
